This rice plot is small but rice needs feeding to give a good harvest, so I will buy a bag of NPK and some urea — I cannot afford to waste the season on weak yields. I learned at school that improved rice seed gives more grain, and the agro-dealer in town stocks FARO varieties, so I will try improved seed this year. Rice has a lot of weeds in our swampy ground here in the South East, so I will spray herbicide to save my back, but I depend on the rains — I have no pump for irrigation. My wife and children will help with planting and weeding, but for transplanting and harvest I will need to hire a few hands.
